# Getting Help with SkillSentry

Thanks for using SkillSentry. Pick the channel that matches what you need.

| You want to | Go here |
|:---|:---|
| Learn how to install, scan, read verdicts, or set up CI | [User guide](../docs/16-user-guide.md) and the [CLI reference](../docs/07-cli-reference.md) |
| Fix a setup problem | Run `skill-sentry-cli doctor` and read the [troubleshooting table](../docs/16-user-guide.md#14-troubleshooting) |
| Report a bug | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/EmberPhantom/SkillSentry/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Request a feature | [Open a feature request](https://github.com/EmberPhantom/SkillSentry/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| Ask a usage or design question | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/EmberPhantom/SkillSentry/discussions) if enabled, otherwise an issue labelled `question` |
| Contribute code or docs | [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Report a security vulnerability | **Do not open a public issue.** Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) |

## Before you ask

Include these, so we can help faster:

- The output of `skill-sentry-cli --version`
- The output of `skill-sentry-cli doctor` (the lines, not a screenshot)
- Your operating system, and whether you run the sandbox or `--no-sandbox`
- The exact command you ran and the full message it printed

Remove anything that is a real credential, a private skill, or a personal path before you paste it.

## Response expectations

SkillSentry is maintained by volunteers. We aim to reply to new issues within a week. Security reports have their own timeline in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
